items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I have a family rhythm section along with Steven on the drums

ctx.x: And then, unfortunately, that marriage finished, and then I met my next wife, who is my present wife, Joanne Roberts, her maiden name was. By that time she was Joanne Gidney from Cleveland, Ohio. She'd previously been married to an excellent pianist in Cleveland, Bill Gidney. And let's see, after about three years I was separated from Blanche, Bunny, we call her, Blanche Flower, in 1960, and then married Joanne Roberts Gidney in 1963. And we have two children of

that marriage, a little girl, Dune, who's now 13 years old, D-u-n-e, and a brother James, who's 14 now. And he's named after my father, and my older brother, were both James. And also Joanne's son by her previous marriage with Bill Gidney is with us now and his name's William, we call him Bill. And Bill is now my adopted son. So his name is not Bill Gidney, it's Bill Wilson now. And let's see, Bill's a senior at Ohio State right now, and graduating this year, 1980. And Steven is enrolled in the Berkeley College…
I don't know if I gave their ages, June is 13 now,
